high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a social media post from the account "galaxies." The post discusses an experiment conducted on the International Space Station to observe combustion in a microgravity environment. The text explains that the experiment used a 50/50 fuel mixture of iso-octane and heptane, tested in a standard air environment (21% oxygen and 79% nitrogen at 1 atm).
